approved: Live Animal Export Prohibition (Ending Cruelty) Bill 2018

The Live Animal Export Prohibition (Ending Cruelty) Bill 2018 would end all live sheep and cattle exports from Australia by 2021 with interim tougher safeguards, citing systemic cruelty (e.g., over 2,000 sheep deaths on the Awassi Express) and arguing the industry is not in Australia's economic interest, damages its reputation, and lacks public support.
